output.subject: Your complaint about your card being blocked while traveling
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about the trouble you had using your card in Phoenix. We have received your complaint, and we're sorry for the frustration and inconvenience this caused while you were away from home.

You told us your card was blocked three times over two days during your trip, even though you had already let us know through the app that you were traveling. You mentioned that each time you had to call, wait on hold and prove your identity, and that a friend ended up lending you cash because you couldn't use your own money. You also made clear that nothing was stolen and nothing was charged incorrectly. You've asked us to fix whatever causes your card to be blocked whenever you leave the state.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for taking the time to tell us about this.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm whether a travel notice was recorded in the app for the Phoenix trip and its dates.
Check the three blocks over two days and why each one was triggered.
Review the hold times and verification steps on the customer's calls.
Decide what, if anything, can be done to prevent future blocks when the customer travels out of state.
Decide whether any goodwill gesture is appropriate; the customer did not ask for one.
The customer listed a cell number; confirm their preferred contact method before replying.
